POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

2. When learning Management of Road Transport, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Management of Road Transport.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Management of Road Transport.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Management of Road Transport.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Management of Road Transport.

3. When learning Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

4. When learning Surface Development of pyramids, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Development of pyramids.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Development of pyramids.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Development of pyramids.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

7. When learning Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

8. When learning Introduction to computer aided drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to computer aided drawing.

9. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

10. When learning Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.

11. When learning Surface Developmen t of prisms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Developmen t of prisms.

12. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly drawing and Sectioning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to computer aided drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

16. (4 marks)
